name: nightwatch
description: a Nightwatch (Fall from Heaven), a secret cloaked watchman of the Council of Esus: a deep charcoal-grey hooded cloak with the hood up, a little orange hair and the eyes showing under the hood, a deep crimson scarf over the lower face with long crimson tails hanging down the front, a small silver mask-shaped badge pinned on the cloak, dark leather armour with brown straps and belt, brown leather bracers, black-and-brown boots, a small brass hooded lantern with a bright amber window raised in his RIGHT hand, and a recurved wooden shortbow with an arrow nocked, held low in his LEFT hand with the arrow pointing to the right
hands: the shortbow, with an arrow nocked, stays in his left hand on the screen-right side, held low at his hip; his right hand on the screen-left side holds the brass lantern up beside him

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; the hooded head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk (the brass lantern flung out to the left in the right hand; the bow hand jerked in to the belt, the shortbow upright behind the body with the arrow still nocked)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent, the bow hand still at the belt and the shortbow tilting back behind the body, the lantern still held out to the left

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-right, body thrown back, the bow arm flung up with the shortbow upright, the lantern drooping in the right hand
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the hooded head droops, the shortbow lowering, the lantern hanging from the right hand
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, one end of the shortbow resting on the ground at the lower-left, the lantern hanging from the right hand
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the shortbow slips out of the hand, the lantern drops beside him, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, the hood still up and the crimson scarf over his face, the grey cloak spread under him; the shortbow lies on the ground at the lower-left; the brass lantern lies on its side beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the grey cloak settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed under the hood, the shortbow on the ground beside him and the brass lantern on its side
